items.title: Section: The Chapter on Ripening Opens — What "Ripening" Actually Means

items.zh: 云何成熟？當知成熟略有六種。一者、成熟自性，二者、所成熟補特伽羅，三者、成熟差別，四者、成熟方便，五者、能成熟補特伽羅，六者、已成熟補特伽羅相。
items.en: What is ripening? It should be understood that, in brief, there are six aspects: first, the nature of ripening; second, the person to be ripened; third, the varieties of ripening; fourth, the means of ripening; fifth, the person who ripens; and sixth, the marks of a person already ripened.

items.zh: 云何成熟自性？謂由有善法種子、及數習諸善法故，獲得能順二障斷淨增上身心有堪任性、極調善性，正加行滿。安住於此，若遇大師、不遇大師，皆有堪任、有大勢力，無間能證煩惱障斷、所知障斷。
譬如癰痤，熟至究竟無間可破，說名為熟。又如瓦器，熟至究竟無間可用，說名為熟。又如眾果，熟至究竟無間可噉；說名為熟。
items.en: Just as a boil, once fully matured, may be lanced without delay — this is called being ripe. Just as pottery, once fully fired, may be used without delay — this is called being ripe. Just as fruit, once fully ripened, may be eaten without delay — this is called being ripe.

items.zh: 如是由有善法種子及數修習諸善法故，獲得能順廣說乃至正加行滿，無間能證二障清淨，說名成熟。如是名為成熟自性。云何所成熟補特伽羅？

items.title: Section: Who Is Ripened — Four Kinds of Being, Each Matched to Their Own Path

items.zh: 謂所成熟補特伽羅略有四種。一者、住聲聞種姓，於聲聞乘應可成熟補特伽羅；二者、住獨覺種姓，於獨覺乘應可成熟補特伽羅；三者、住佛種姓，於無上乘應可成熟補特伽羅；四者、住無種姓，於住善趣應可成熟補特伽羅。
items.en: The persons to be ripened are, in brief, of four kinds: first, those settled in the hearer lineage, who should be ripened towards the hearer's vehicle; second, those settled in the solitary-buddha lineage, who should be ripened towards the solitary-buddha's vehicle; third, those settled in the buddha lineage, who should be ripened towards the unsurpassed vehicle; and fourth, those with no fixed lineage at all, who should be ripened towards favourable rebirth.

items.zh: 諸佛菩薩於此四事，應當成熟如是四種補特伽羅。是名所成熟補特伽羅。云何成熟差別？謂此差別略有六種。一、諸根成熟，二、善根成熟，三、智慧成熟，四、下品成熟，五、中品成熟，六、上品成熟。

items.title: Section: Three Kinds of Ripening — And the Three Obstructions Each One Overcomes

items.zh: 諸根成熟者，謂壽量具足、形色具足、族姓具足、自在具足、信言具足、大勢具足、人性具足、大力具足。此依身果異熟具足為所依故，堪任發起勇猛精進，修諸善法，於勤修集一切明處心無厭倦。
items.en: Ripening of the faculties: complete longevity, complete fine appearance, complete noble birth, complete authority, complete credibility, complete influence, complete rapport with others, and complete strength. Resting on this complete bodily fruit of karmic ripening, they become capable of arousing vigorous diligence, cultivating every wholesome practice, and diligently mastering every field of knowledge without ever growing weary.

items.zh: 善根成熟者，謂性薄塵垢為所依止，性於諸惡不善法中心不樂入；諸蓋輕微，尋思薄弱，柔和正直，隨順而取。智慧成熟者，謂具足正念，為性聰敏，有所堪任、有大勢力，能解善說、惡說法義，能受、能持、能正通達，具足成熟俱生妙慧。依此妙慧，有所堪任、有大勢力，能令其心究竟解脫一切煩惱。
當知此中，諸根成熟故，解脫異熟障；善根成熟故，能解脫業障；智慧成熟故，解脫煩惱障。
items.en: It should be understood that, through the ripening of the faculties, one is freed from the obstruction of karmic ripening; through the ripening of wholesome roots, one is freed from the obstruction of karma; and through the ripening of wisdom, one is freed from the obstruction of affliction.

items.title: Three Grades of Ripening — Inferior, Middling, and Superior

items.zh: 下品成熟者，謂二因緣下品成熟。一者、未久修習，諸根、善根、智慧成熟因緣未極增長；二者、串習下劣因緣。
items.en: Inferior ripening arises from two conditions: first, cultivation has not yet continued long enough for the causes of the faculties', wholesome roots', and wisdom's ripening to fully increase; second, one remains habituated to inferior conditions.

items.zh: 中品成熟者，謂即於此二種因緣，隨一闕減，隨一具足。上品成熟者，謂二因緣俱無闕減。
items.en: Middling ripening is when, of these same two conditions, one is lacking while the other is fulfilled. Superior ripening is when both conditions are fulfilled without any deficiency at all.

items.title: Section: Twenty-Seven Means of Ripening Open — Growing the Seed, and Embracing Present Conditions

items.zh: 當知此有二十七種。一者、界增長，二者、現緣攝受，三者、趣入，四者、攝樂，五者、初發處，六者、非初發處，七者、遠清淨，八者、近清淨，九者、加行，十者、意樂，十一者、財攝受，十二者、法攝受，十三者、神通引攝，十四者、宣說正法，十五者、隱密說法，十六者、顯了說法，十七者、下品加行，十八者、中品加行，十九者、上品加行，二十者、聽聞，二十一者、思惟，二十二者、修習，二十三者、攝受，二十四者、降伏，二十五者、自成熟，二十六者、請他成熟，二十七者、俱成熟。
items.en: It should be understood that there are twenty-seven of these: growth of the lineage-seed; embracing present conditions; entry; delighting attraction; the point of initial arousal; what is not the point of initial arousal; distant purification; near purification; application; aspiration; attraction through wealth; attraction through teaching; guidance through miraculous power; explicit teaching of the true Dharma; teaching through hidden meaning; teaching made fully explicit; inferior application; middling application; superior application; hearing; reflection; cultivation; embracing; subduing; self-ripening; requesting another's ripening; and mutual ripening.

items.zh: 界增長者，謂本性善法種子具足為所依止，先來串習諸善法故，後後位中善法種子轉增轉勝，生起堅住。是名界增長。現緣攝受者，謂於現法中無倒說法、無倒受持，如理修行法隨法行。
items.en: Growth of the lineage-seed: resting on wholesome seeds already innately possessed, and having previously cultivated wholesome practices, the seeds of wholesome practice grow progressively stronger and more excellent at each further stage, arising and remaining firmly established. This is called growth of the lineage-seed. Embracing present conditions: in this very life, teaching without error, receiving that teaching without error, and practising correctly in accordance with the teaching received.

items.zh: 當知界增長，由先世因現在成熟；現緣攝受，由現在因現在成熟。

blocks.text: The chapter on **ripening** (成熟品): how buddhas and bodhisattvas bring beings to maturity. A short passage (0496c27) is untranslated.
The nature of ripening; those to be ripened; varieties; means; those who ripen; and the marks of the ripened.

"Just as a boil, fully matured, may be lanced without delay; as pottery, fully fired, may be used without delay; as fruit, fully ripened, may be eaten": so a being, ripened, is ready for the path. Venerable Miào Jìng: "when fully ripe, you needn't wait."

Four kinds: those of the hearer lineage, ripened towards the hearer vehicle; those of the solitary-buddha lineage; those of the bodhisattva lineage; and "those with no fixed lineage, ripened towards favourable rebirth". Master Cháng Bǎi: for the last, at most one can teach them to avoid evil.
Of the **faculties** (the eight ripened qualities, Day 313); of **wholesome roots**; of **wisdom**. They free one, respectively, from the obstruction of karmic ripening, of karma, and of affliction.

Inferior: cultivation not yet long enough, and still habituated to inferior conditions. Master Cháng Bǎi: rationalising one's own lack of progress is "inferior". Middling: one condition lacking. Superior: both fulfilled.

Growing the lineage seed; embracing present conditions ("teaching without error, receiving it without error, practising accordingly"); entry; delight; initial arousal; and so on, to be listed over the next days.

quiz.q: "Like a boil, fully matured, lanced without delay." How does Venerable Miào Jìng explain?
options: fully ripe, no more waiting — operate
quiz.why: "Just as a boil, once fully matured, may be lanced without delay — this is called being ripe." Venerable Miào Jìng: when fully ripe, you needn't wait any longer — you can operate.

quiz.q: "What is ripening?" What two senses do the masters give?
options: Cháng Bǎi, after the Lùnjì: ripening beings (others) and ripening buddha-qualities (self); Miào Jìng: practising to the noble path ripens one's own qualities, and compassion ripens beings
quiz.why: "What is ripening? It should be understood that, in brief, there are six aspects." Master Cháng Bǎi, citing the Yújiā lùnjì: first, ripening beings — benefiting others; second, ripening buddha-qualities — benefiting self. Venerable Miào Jìng: practising oneself to attain the noble path is ripening one's own buddha-qualities; having great compassion, one also ripens beings.

quiz.q: The fourth: "those with no lineage, ripened towards favourable rebirth." How far can they be taught, per Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: at most: avoid evil, do good — human and heavenly virtue
quiz.why: "Fourth, those with no fixed lineage at all, who should be ripened towards favourable rebirth." Master Cháng Bǎi: at most one can teach them to avoid evil and do good — the virtues of humans and gods.

quiz.q: The three ripenings free one from the obstructions of ripening, karma, and affliction. Where do all three come from, per Master Cháng Bǎi?
options: all from affliction — without affliction, none remain
quiz.why: "Through the ripening of the faculties, one is freed from the obstruction of karmic ripening; through the ripening of wholesome roots, from the obstruction of karma; through the ripening of wisdom, from the obstruction of affliction." Master Cháng Bǎi: all three obstructions come from affliction; without affliction, none of them remain.

quiz.q: Inferior ripening comes partly from "habituation to inferior conditions." What does Master Cháng Bǎi say?
options: rationalising one's lack of progress — that's inferior ripening
quiz.why: "Second, one remains habituated to inferior conditions." Master Cháng Bǎi: rationalising the reasons for one's own lack of progress — that's inferior ripening.

quiz.q: "Growth of the lineage-seed: wholesome seeds grow stronger at each stage." What does Master Cháng Bǎi say?
options: seeds produce manifestations, manifestations perfume seeds — growing endlessly
quiz.why: "Growth of the lineage-seed: resting on wholesome seeds already innately possessed … the seeds of wholesome practice grow progressively stronger and more excellent at each further stage." Master Cháng Bǎi: seeds give rise to manifestations, manifestations perfume seeds — continually growing.

quiz.q: Embracing present conditions: "practising in accordance with the Dharma (法隨法行)." How does Master Cháng Bǎi explain?
options: 法 is nirvāṇa; 隨法 the eightfold path leading to it
quiz.why: "Embracing present conditions: in this very life, teaching without error, receiving that teaching without error, and practising correctly in accordance with the teaching received." Master Cháng Bǎi: in 法隨法行, 法 means nirvāṇa; 隨法 means teachings conforming to nirvāṇa — the eightfold path.
